description:
Update the command reference for the changed `issue create`, `validate --fix` and `doc check-links` behaviour.

## Background

- `docs/reference/cli-commands.md` documents `jit issue create` (`:899` onwards), `jit doc check-links` (`:2841` onwards) and `jit validate --fix` (`:3249-3334`); `docs/reference/worktree-validate.md` documents `--fix` (`:367-368,449`).
- `docs/how-to/multi-agent-coordination.md:421-425` tells readers to verify with plain `jit validate` because a `--fix` run that applies no fix reports `No fixes needed` without re-checking. Other pages only show the command.
- Changed behaviour: `issue create` returns `findings` in JSON and prints the same findings in human output, and `--force` no longer hides them; `validate --fix` publishes every fix through one mutation and renders one report over the fixed repository, with its exit status, including when it applied no fix; `doc check-links` probes each distinct external URL once, with a request timeout and bounded concurrency.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: The `issue create`, `validate --fix` and `doc check-links` sections state the changed behaviour above.
- [hard] REQ-02: No page under `docs/` describes `--fix` as publishing one mutation per fix or as skipping validation after a run that applied no fix.

## Notes

- Written against the code as it stands after the changes this one follows; line citations name current code.
title: Command references describe create findings, fix reporting and link probing
